facts.fact: The Bureau of Statistics' 2022 Vital Statistics Report states that vital-event data are routinely collected by Ministry of Home Affairs staff from all districts and compiled at the ministry's headquarters, through its National Identity and Civil Registry department; the preface is undated, so the report's publication year of 2024 is used (reference year 2022), and it does not say whether collection in the districts is electronic.
